title: Isolation, structural re-elucidation of two active prenylated flavonoids from Morus alba L. twigs responsible for anti-inflammatory effects: an in vitro and in silico approach.
authors: Tran, Le Viet Ha; Vo, Huu Canh; Nguyen, Tran Dang Linh; Long, To Hoang; Le, Minh-Tri; Thai, Khac-Minh; Nguyen, Truc Ly; Nguyen, Van-Kieu; Tran, Huynh Nguyen Khanh
one_liner_zh: 该文从桑枝中分离两种异戊烯基黄酮并利用分子对接评估其与炎症相关蛋白（含NF-κB等转录因子）的结合，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: ETHNOBOTANICAL RELEVANCE: Morus alba L. has been reported to exhibit various pharmacological effects, including antipyretic, hepatoprotective, nephroprotective, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory activities, as well as benefits for sore throat relief and eyesight improvement in traditional medicine. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study investigates the anti-inflammatory potential of two prenylated flavonoids isolated from the twigs of Morus alba L. METHODS: The methanol extract and ethyl acetate (EA)-soluble fraction exhibited inhibitory effects on nitric oxide (NO) production. These fractions were further purified using repeated open-column chromatographic techniques, including liquid-liquid partitioning, normal-phase (NP) and reversed-phase (RP) chromatography, Sephadex gel filtration, and preparative HPLC. The chemical structures of compounds 1 and 2 were elucidated based on comprehensive spectroscopic analyses, including 1D and 2D NMR, experimental circular dichroism (CD), and specific optical rotation, along with comparison to reported data in the literature. The inhibitory effects on NO production and cell viability were evaluated in RAW 264.7 macrophage cells using the MTT assay. In addition, molecular docking and pharmacokinetic property predictions were performed for the two promising compounds. RESULTS: The methanol extract and ethyl acetate (EA)-soluble fraction exhibited inhibitory effects on nitric oxide (NO) production, showing 65 % inhibition at 100 mug/mL. These fractions underwent bioassay-guided fractionation, leading to the isolation of morusoin A (1) and (-)-mulberranol (2), two bioactive prenylated flavonoids. Compounds 1 and 2 significantly inhibited NO production in a dose-dependent manner without affecting cell viability. Furthermore, molecular docking studies were performed to evaluate the interactions of these two flavonoids with key pro-inflammatory cytokines and transcription factors (iNOS, COX-2, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, Nrf2, and NF-kappaB) to elucidate their potential anti-inflammatory mechanisms. The binding energies were calculated as -9.0/-8.0, -9.1/-9.6, -6.0/-6.2, -6.0/-5.6, -6.5/-6.8, -7.1/-9.4, and -8.8/-9.5 kcal/mol, respectively. In addition, in silico ADMET and toxicity analyses were performed, providing an overview of the pharmacokinetic and safety profiles of the two compounds. CONCLUSION: Compounds 1 and 2 have been well studied for isolation, structural elucidation, and their anti-inflammatory effects using both in vitro and in silico approaches and indicated that 1 and 2 possessed potential anti-inflammatory activity mediated via the Nrf2/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, warranting supporting their further evaluation in in vitro and in vivo models.
abstract_zh: 民族植物学相关性：桑（Morus alba L.）已被报道具有多种药理作用，包括解热、保肝、保肾、降压和抗炎活性，以及在传统医学中对缓解咽喉疼痛和改善视力的益处。研究目的：本研究探讨了从桑枝中分离出的两种异戊烯基黄酮类化合物的抗炎潜力。方法：甲醇提取物和乙酸乙酯（EA）可溶部分对一氧化氮（NO）产生表现出抑制作用。这些部分通过重复的开放柱色谱技术进一步纯化，包括液-液分配、正相（NP）和反相（RP）色谱、Sephadex凝胶过滤和制备型HPLC。化合物1和2的化学结构基于综合光谱分析阐明，包括1D和2D NMR、实验圆二色光谱（CD）和比旋光度，并与文献中报道的数据进行比较。在RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中使用MTT法评估了对NO产生和细胞活力的抑制作用。此外，对这两种有前景的化合物进行了分子对接和药代动力学性质预测。结果：甲醇提取物和乙酸乙酯（EA）可溶部分对一氧化氮（NO）产生表现出抑制作用，在100 μg/mL时显示65%的抑制率。这些部分经过生物测定指导的分馏，导致分离出morusoin A（1）和(-)-mulberranol（2），两种具有生物活性的异戊烯基黄酮类化合物。化合物1和2以剂量依赖性方式显著抑制NO产生，且不影响细胞活力。此外，进行了分子对接研究，以评估这两种黄酮类化合物与关键促炎细胞因子和转录因子（iNOS、COX-2、TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、Nrf2和NF-κB）的相互作用，以阐明其潜在的抗炎机制。结合能分别计算为-9.0/-8.0、-9.1/-9.6、-6.0/-6.2、-6.0/-5.6、-6.5/-6.8、-7.1/-9.4和-8.8/-9.5 kcal/mol。此外，进行了计算机模拟ADMET和毒性分析，提供了这两种化合物的药代动力学和安全性概况。结论：化合物1和2已通过体外和计算机模拟方法在分离、结构阐明及其抗炎作用方面得到充分研究，表明1和2具有通过Nrf2/NF-κB信号通路介导的潜在抗炎活性，支持其在体外和体内模型中的进一步评估。
